title: Looking for frontend with media optimization

feed.title: Looking for frontend with media optimization
feed.description:
## Frontend Developer — React + TypeScript + Vite

We’re hiring a **Frontend Developer** to take ownership of the frontend at **Matify.io** — *The Cinematic AI Studio for Ultra-Realistic Content.*

Matify is a media-heavy AI content creation platform, so this role needs someone strong in **frontend performance, media optimization, CDN-based asset delivery, image/video previews, uploads, and smooth user experiences.**

### Responsibilities

* Build and maintain frontend features using React, TypeScript, and Vite
* Develop clean, reusable UI components with Tailwind CSS
* Integrate REST APIs using Axios
* Manage server state using TanStack React Query
* Handle global state using Zustand
* Build smooth UI interactions with Framer Motion
* Work with image/video previews, uploads, generated outputs, and CDN assets
* Optimize lazy loading, caching, loading states, page speed, and responsiveness
* Debug production issues and improve frontend quality
* Collaborate with backend, AI, design, and product teams

### Required Skills

React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, TanStack React Query, Axios, Zustand, Framer Motion, React routing libraries, Lucide React, ESLint, Git, REST APIs, responsive UI, frontend performance optimization, media handling, and CDN-based asset delivery.

### Nice to Have

Experience with AI products, image/video platforms, Vercel deployment, authentication, file uploads, JSZip, accessibility, and CI/CD workflows.

### What We’re Looking For

Someone who can write clean production-ready code, take ownership of the frontend, solve media-heavy performance challenges, and build a fast, premium user experience for Matify.io.

📩 Interested candidates can share their profile/portfolio.
